members_email_active_key.name: members_email_active_key
members_email_active_key.where: "members"."archived_at" is null and "members"."email" is not null

members_email_length.name: members_email_length
members_email_length.value: "members"."email" is null or char_length("members"."email") between 3 and 254

membership_plans_duration_matches_type.name: membership_plans_duration_matches_type
membership_plans_duration_matches_type.value:
case "membership_plans"."plan_type"
        when 'MONTHLY' then "membership_plans"."duration_unit" = 'MONTH' and "membership_plans"."duration_value" = 1
        when 'QUARTERLY' then "membership_plans"."duration_unit" = 'MONTH' and "membership_plans"."duration_value" = 3
        when 'SIX_MONTH' then "membership_plans"."duration_unit" = 'MONTH' and "membership_plans"."duration_value" = 6
        when 'ANNUAL' then "membership_plans"."duration_unit" = 'MONTH' and "membership_plans"."duration_value" = 12
        else true end

membership_plans_access_days_valid.name: membership_plans_access_days_valid
membership_plans_access_days_valid.value: "membership_plans"."access_days" is null or (cardinality("membership_plans"."access_days") between 1 and 7 and "membership_plans"."access_days" <@ array[1,2,3,4,5,6,7]::smallint[])

membership_plans_access_hours_valid.name: membership_plans_access_hours_valid
membership_plans_access_hours_valid.value: ("membership_plans"."access_start_time" is null and "membership_plans"."access_end_time" is null) or ("membership_plans"."access_start_time" is not null and "membership_plans"."access_end_time" is not null and "membership_plans"."access_start_time" < "membership_plans"."access_end_time")

memberships_activation_recorded.name: memberships_activation_recorded
memberships_activation_recorded.value: "memberships"."status" not in ('ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED', 'EXPIRED') or "memberships"."activated_at" is not null

access_attempts_granted_is_complete.name: access_attempts_granted_is_complete
access_attempts_granted_is_complete.value: "access_attempts"."result" = 'DENIED' or ("access_attempts"."member_id" is not null and "access_attempts"."membership_id" is not null and "access_attempts"."attendance_id" is not null)

access_devices_simulated_has_no_hardware.name: access_devices_simulated_has_no_hardware
access_devices_simulated_has_no_hardware.value: "access_devices"."device_type" = 'REAL' or ("access_devices"."vendor" is null and "access_devices"."model" is null and "access_devices"."serial_number" is null)

biometric_enrollments_deleted_has_no_ref.name: biometric_enrollments_deleted_has_no_ref
biometric_enrollments_deleted_has_no_ref.value: ("biometric_enrollments"."status" = 'DELETED') = ("biometric_enrollments"."template_ref" is null) and ("biometric_enrollments"."status" = 'DELETED') = ("biometric_enrollments"."deleted_at" is not null)

invoices_void_consistent.name: invoices_void_consistent
invoices_void_consistent.value:
("invoices"."status" = 'VOID') = ("invoices"."voided_at" is not null)
        and ("invoices"."voided_at" is null or "invoices"."void_reason" is not null)

workout_logs_actuals.name: workout_logs_actuals
workout_logs_actuals.value:
coalesce("workout_logs"."actual_sets", 0) between 0 and 20 and coalesce("workout_logs"."actual_reps", 0) between 0 and 100
        and coalesce("workout_logs"."actual_duration_seconds", 0) between 0 and 7200

workout_plan_items_reps_or_duration.name: workout_plan_items_reps_or_duration
workout_plan_items_reps_or_duration.value: "workout_plan_items"."reps" is not null or "workout_plan_items"."duration_seconds" is not null

notification_deliveries_outcome.name: notification_deliveries_outcome
notification_deliveries_outcome.value:
("notification_deliveries"."status" = 'SENT') = ("notification_deliveries"."provider_message_id" is not null)
        and ("notification_deliveries"."status" = 'FAILED') = ("notification_deliveries"."error_code" is not null)
